culture.title: Houses beside the Junyuan River
culture.text: The Junyuan River crosses Youshan between rows of Hui-style houses. Zhao Huafu’s village field study describes five stone bridges connecting the riverbanks; the town government’s 2023 account also records repairs to the river channel and stone-paved lanes.

source.title: Zhao Huafu · Youshan Dong-lineage field study, opening description

culture.title: Jiahui Hall
culture.text: Zhao Huafu’s field study describes Jiahui Hall in the centre of Youshan: a gate hall, a courtyard and spaces for ceremonies and ancestral tablets. Its account distinguishes the village’s common ancestral hall from the smaller halls of individual lineage branches.

source.title: Zhao Huafu · Youshan Dong-lineage field study, section 1

soundNotes.title: 女 and 呂
soundNotes.text: In the 2015 Youshan sample, 女 [ny31] and 呂 [li31] differ in both initial and vowel. Both carry the source’s 31 pitch contour. 男 and 欄 share [num21], while 農 and 龍 share [nɑm21].

soundNotes.title: A vowel followed by [ɔ]
soundNotes.text: The Youshan sample contrasts 毛 [ma21] with 茅 [maɔ21], and 高 [ka33] with 交 [kaɔ33]. Each pair keeps the same pitch contour while the second reading adds [ɔ]. These are the source’s character readings from one 2015 speaker.

resources.title: A field study of Youshan village

resources.title: Youshan heritage conservation
resources.description: Zhentou Town government’s August 2023 reply identifies Youshan village and documents its historic buildings, lane repairs and conservation plans. Read the official reply below the resident’s request.
